correctness.rationale: For i outside the three neighboring positions, record and peak events are independent by disjoint sampling or independent insertion ranks. Conditional Beta(j,1) and Beta(j-1,1) calculations give exact joint moments at i=j and i=j-1; i=j+1 has zero joint probability. Subtracting marginals gives all local entries and telescoping gives the aggregate. Independent record Bernoullis and 2-dependent peak moments yield the stated variance/correlation. The extracted stand-alone Python verifier passed 150 exact assertions for every permutation at n=3..8; the general analytic argument covers all n>=3.

value.rationale: The statistic couples global prefix-record events to local turning points in iid continuous ranks, both standard distribution-free diagnostics. The complete banded kernel locates all positive and negative local dependence, and the cubic peak-position contribution reveals a nontrivial cancellation mechanism. Consequently covariance tends to a nonzero constant 1/12 even though correlation tends to zero at the precise rate 1/sqrt(n log n). This is not determined by the familiar marginal record or peak laws and provides structural dependence information useful for joint calibration of rank diagnostics.
